editorial.claim: Readers should note that the video was released two days after the incident, and the only available audio is Clarkson’s social‑media post.
The incident highlights how a well‑known performer’s experience can spark broader conversations about customer service and bias.
The situation also illustrates the role of social media in shaping narratives.
